role.title: AI Engineer
role.focus: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, LLM applications, RAG and AI backend systems
role.objective: Build, evaluate, deploy and maintain reliable AI-powered products.

responsibilities.1: Develop ML and deep-learning solutions using Python.
responsibilities.2: Prepare, clean and analyze structured and unstructured data.
responsibilities.3: Train, validate and evaluate machine-learning models.
responsibilities.5: Integrate LLM APIs and open-source models into applications.
responsibilities.6: Design RAG pipelines with chunking, embeddings and vector search.
responsibilities.7: Implement tool-calling and agentic workflows where appropriate.
responsibilities.8: Build REST APIs for AI services using FastAPI.
responsibilities.9: Write tests and maintain clean, modular production code.
responsibilities.10: Containerize and deploy AI applications using Docker and cloud platforms.
responsibilities.11: Monitor latency, cost, accuracy and failure cases.
responsibilities.12: Document experiments, APIs, datasets and model decisions.

qualifications.education: Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML or related field; strong equivalent self-learning is acceptable.
qualifications.experience: Projects, internships, open-source contributions or practical AI applications.
qualifications.portfolio: At least 2 substantial projects with deployed demos or documented technical implementations.

1.name: Production RAG Knowledge Assistant
1.description: Build a document intelligence platform that ingests PDFs and web documents, extracts and cleans content, creates semantic chunks, generates embeddings, stores them in a vector database, retrieves relevant passages and produces grounded answers with citations.

2.name: AI Resume and Job Description Analyzer
2.description: Build an AI recruitment assistant that parses resumes and job descriptions, extracts skills and experience, compares candidate evidence against role requirements, identifies missing skills and generates targeted learning recommendations using a RAG knowledge base.

3.name: Agentic Data and Automation Platform
3.description: Build an AI agent that accepts business questions, selects approved tools, queries SQL data, performs Python-based analysis, generates charts or reports and returns an auditable answer with the executed actions and supporting data.
